description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Scans text for emails, phone numbers, US SSNs, payment card numbers (Luhn-checked), IBANs (checksum-checked), IP addresses and secrets (API keys such as sk-..., AKIA..., ghp_..., xoxb-..., private keys and 0x-prefixed 64-hex keys), and returns the text redacted: label mode gives the same value the same placeholder ([EMAIL_1]) so the text still reads, mask keeps the last 4 characters, remove deletes. Findings list type, position and a masked preview, never the full value. Pattern and checksum based: it will not catch names or street addresses.

types.description: which kinds to find, default all

name: pii_redact
title: Find and redact personal data and secrets in text before it is logged or shared
